resources.string: Enable or disable automatic copying of audio files to a folder you choose.

The selected files were processed. Verified copies are available in Files.
A temporary output could not be removed. Restore folder access and reopen the app to retry cleanup of recorded copy outputs. Check the destination for files starting with .audio-copier-.
The local operation history could not be loaded. Check free storage and reopen the app.

Select both folders and pass the access test before copying.
The previous operation was interrupted. Select the source folder, test access and retry.
Reading or writing failed. Check folder access and available storage, then retry.
Choose a folder from internal storage or an SD card using the system picker. Cloud and other provider folders are not supported in this stage.
This folder contains too many entries for this manual scan. Choose a smaller source or destination folder.
The file or folder is no longer available. Refresh the list or select the folder again.
The file is empty, its size is unknown, or it is still changing. Wait until the recording finishes, then retry.
No app could open this copy, or access was lost. The copy may still exist in the destination folder.
Choose two separate folders. Neither folder may contain the other.
Folder access is no longer available. Choose the folders again and repeat the access test.
The system folder picker could not be opened. Check that the system Files app is enabled.
The source changed during copying. The incomplete copy was removed. Wait until writing finishes, then retry.
There is not enough free storage to complete the operation. Free some space, then retry.
The operation could not be completed. Retry and report the action that failed if the problem continues.
The copied contents could not be verified. The operation was not marked successful. Retry after checking storage.

Choose a writable local folder separate from the source; neither folder may contain the other. Copying cannot start without a valid destination. The app tests access with a temporary file, verifies each copy by size and SHA-256, and adds a number if a filename already exists. The file list contains copies managed by this app only. Delete and rename never target originals.

Android does not expose reliable weekly energy consumption for this app through a public API. Unavailable is shown instead of an estimate presented as fact. The button opens system battery settings when supported; the period and detail shown there depend on the device.

When enabled, existing AAC files are recorded as a baseline without copying them. New files are checked about every 20 seconds during active monitoring and must have stable metadata across checks before copying. This cannot prove that a recording app will not resume writing later. Background monitoring needs a persistent notification and remains subject to Android limits, including the Android 15 dataSync time quota. WorkManager schedules fallback checks at a minimum interval of 15 minutes, which can be delayed. Turning background work off limits monitoring to when the app is visible. Force-stop prevents scheduled work until the app is opened again. Restarting automatic copying establishes a new baseline; files that arrived while it was stopped can be selected manually.

Choose the local folder where recordings are saved. Subfolders are included. The app reads originals without changing or deleting them. Automatic copying watches AAC files; files already present when you enable it are excluded. To copy existing audio, use the existing-files switch and select files. Changing a folder stops monitoring until you enable it again.

Storage combines the app package and private data (including cache) with the measured sizes of accessible copies managed by the app. Cache is not counted twice. Folder metadata and physical disk allocation are not always measurable through the folder provider. If copy access is lost, the value is unavailable. Clearing cache never deletes recordings, copies, settings or history. The new-files counter counts successful automatic copies over time, including copies later deleted; manually selected old files and duplicate attempts are excluded.
Watching for new AAC files. Tap to open.
Continuous monitoring could not start. Copying remains enabled while the app is open, and background checks are scheduled. Allow notifications and reopen the app to try active background monitoring.
This audio could not be played. Its format may be unsupported, or access to the copy may have been lost.
